title: Yuval Aroosh presents at ABC Social Robotics
description: Our MSc student Yuval Aroosh presented a poster on Adaptive Stochastic Action Perturbations at the ABC Social Robotics mini-conference.

title: Five DRIVE Lab MSc students submit their theses
description: Congratulations to Lidor Erez, Harel Gil, Amit Gedj, Gal Ram, and Eden Hindi on submitting their MSc theses for review!

title: Ayal Taitler becomes an IEEE Senior Member
description: Ayal Taitler was elevated to IEEE Senior Member.

title: ISFAI 2027 announced
description: Ayal Taitler and Nadav Merlis are co-chairing the Israeli Symposium on the Foundations of Artificial Intelligence (ISFAI 2027), taking place on February 10, 2027, at the Technion.

title: Research presented at PlanRob 2026
description: Our work on dynamics-aware refinement of hybrid plans for physically feasible robotic execution was presented at the ICAPS 2026 Planning and Robotics workshop in Dublin.

title: Research presented at LM4Plan 2026
description: Our work on evaluating per-domain generalization using LLMs, theorem provers, and statistical model checking was presented at the ICAPS 2026 LM4Plan workshop in Dublin.

title: Research presented at PRL 2026
description: Our work on model-driven policy optimization via stochastic exploration was presented at the ICAPS 2026 PRL workshop in Dublin.

title: Amit Gedj presents at ICUAS 2026
description: Amit Gedj presented our research, Disturbance-Aware Data-Driven Optimal Altitude Control of UAVs, at the International Conference on Unmanned Aircraft Systems (ICUAS 2026) in Greece.

title: ICAPS 2027 Summer School co-chair announced
description: Ayal Taitler will co-chair the ICAPS 2027 Summer School in South Carolina, USA, in June 2027.

title: Dr. Santosh Kumar joins DRIVE Lab
description: We welcome Dr. Santosh Kumar to DRIVE Lab as a postdoctoral researcher.
